scenarios.title: Fetch full orderbook for a token and display bid/ask depth
scenarios.event: User asks for the orderbook on a specific prediction market
scenarios.expectedAction: Fetch orderbook via CLOB API, display top levels with total liquidity

scenarios.title: Calculate spread and midpoint for a market
scenarios.event: User asks what the current spread is on a token
scenarios.expectedAction: Fetch bid/ask, calculate spread value and percentage, report midpoint

scenarios.title: Estimate fill price for a $500 market buy
scenarios.event: User asks how much slippage they'd get buying $500 worth
scenarios.expectedAction: Walk orderbook, calculate average fill price and slippage from mid

scenarios.title: Batch query prices for 10 tokens
scenarios.event: User asks for current prices across multiple markets
scenarios.expectedAction: Use batch POST endpoint, return prices for all tokens efficiently

scenarios.title: Token ID has no active orderbook
scenarios.event: User queries a token that has been resolved or has no orders
scenarios.expectedAction: Report empty orderbook with explanation that market may be resolved

scenarios.title: Spread exceeds $0.10 threshold
scenarios.event: User queries a low-liquidity market with wide spread
scenarios.expectedAction: Report spread with warning that Polymarket UI shows last trade price instead of mid when spread > $0.10

criteria: Orderbook correctly parsed with price/size levels: Does the skill fetch and parse bid/ask data accurately?
Spread and midpoint calculated correctly: Does the skill compute spread value and percentage accurately?
Fill estimation walks orderbook for accurate slippage: Does the skill simulate order execution through the book?
Batch queries handle multiple tokens efficiently: Does the skill use batch endpoints for multi-token queries?
Price history returns data at correct intervals: Does the skill query and parse historical price points?
Output includes sufficient data for downstream analysis: Does the output feed into analyzer and strategy skills?
